title: Single-row UTF-8 bind encoder
impact: Extends exp 186's single-row large-text encoder from ASCII-only to direct UTF-8 for non-ASCII parameter lists, reusing the wide-batch `_utf8Length` / `_writeUtf8` helpers and removing the temporary `utf8.encode()` list plus second copy. The broadened `single_row_large_text_bind.dart` CJK rows improve **~31% to ~39%** at 16 KB through 1 MB across an order-flipped pair; ASCII controls stay comparable because the exp 186 all-ASCII fast path is preserved. Adds single-row multibyte + embedded-NUL correctness coverage. Runtime code change; held in review.
